technique_name: Analyze the literary devices used in this excerpt
description: The literary devices used in this excerpt include imagery to convey the atmosphere of loneliness and sadness, personification to give human characteristics to the rain, and repetition of the sound "sss" in the words "solitary" and "cloaked" to emphasize the sense of loneliness and sadness.
example: He was alone in the rain, a solitary figure cloaked in a deep, dark sadness.
